primaryResearchFactCheck.title: Photo-initiated solvent-mediated depolymerization of consumer poly(methyl methacrylate) without chlorinated reagents
primaryResearchFactCheck.actualRead: Abstract and introduction, primary research on PMC; Nature direct open first failed cookie redirect, then primary indexed article and PMC full text read
primaryResearchFactCheck.limitedInference: PMMA can yield MMA under suitable depolymerization and recovered monomer can be repolymerized. Conditions, purity and recovery matter. No numerical teaching-plant values, equipment procedure or universal commercial ranking are inferred from this paper.
